title: Flamurtari win Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2022/23 season
description: Flamurtari have won the Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2022/23 season finishing with an 11-1 record on top. In the last game Flamurtari overcame Skenderbeu 61-49. Eraldo Kollovi (197-C-1998) top-scored for the winners with 16 points and Marsel Sotiri (1993) netted 12. Armelind Sotiri (2001) produced 11, whilst Marko Miranovic (190-G-1990) nailed 10. Bruno Topi (G-1991) replied with 22 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: Flamurtari win Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2022/23 season (Photo: Facebook)

title: Apolonia win Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2021/22 season
description: Apolonia have won the Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2021/22 season beating Flamurtari 85-69 in the last game. Joseph Cortesio (198-F) stepped up with 22 points and Joshua Dennis (195-F-1998, college: Molloy) delivered 20. Demetrious Floyd (183-PG-1993, college: SF Austin) followed them with 16 points in a win. Igli Berdo (G-1996) and Felis Zinxhiria (2005) replied with 21 points each in a loss.
imageCaption: Apolonia win Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2021/22 season (Photo: fshb.basketball)

title: Kamza Basket win Division 1 title
description: Kamza Basket have won Division 1 title as they finished on top undefeated. In the last game they edged Dinamo 88-79. The latter finished second, while Elbasani is third. Elbasani overcame Apolonia 85-73, whilst Apolonia edged Flamurtari 55-48 in the latest game. Flamurtari managed to win only one game in the League.
imageCaption: Kamza Basket win Division 1 title (Photo: Facebook)
